image_description: A close-up, macro photograph of a chiton (marine mollusk) clinging to a wet, rocky substrate. The subject displays a segmented dorsal shell consisting of multiple overlapping plates surrounded by a textured girdle. A small gastropod shell is visible in the upper background.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Head is reduced without eyes or tentacles.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The anterior end of the organism is visible and appears blunt and smooth, lacking any protruding eyes, antennae, or tentacles, consistent with chiton anatomy.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Anterior end is blunt and indistinct.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The front edge of the animal (bottom left) forms a continuous curve with the body wall, showing no distinct head separation.
The surface texture is uniform leathery skin and shell; no sensory organs are discernible.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Dorsal surface protected by eight overlapping calcareous plates arranged in linear series.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Multiple distinct, transverse ridges (plates) are clearly visible running across the width of the body, separated by sutures. While the exact count of 8 is hard to verify due to angle/occlusion, the structural arrangement is correct.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Plates embedded in tough leathery girdle that may be smooth, spiny, or hairy.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A distinct peripheral band (girdle) surrounds the central plates. It has a granular, leathery texture different from the smoother plates.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Plate coloration ranges from grey, brown, green to mottled patterns.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The plates exhibit a mottled pattern of grey, olive-green, and brownish tones, matching the description.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Ventral surface features broad muscular foot for adhesion to rocky substrates.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The image is a dorsal/top-down view; the ventral foot is completely occluded by the body against the rock.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Body exhibits dorsoventrally flattened profile when clinging to surfaces.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The organism conforms tightly to the curvature of the rock surface, exhibiting a low-profile, flattened shape typical of adhesion.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Can curl into defensive ball when dislodged.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: This is a behavioral state not depicted in a static image of an attached animal.
